_: Foundry's shelf. Each app here with a "dir" is built, signed with the release key and published by .github/workflows/android.yml whenever its folder changes. An app without a "dir" is built in its own repo and published to its release here by that repo's workflow (SayTap: mentifaber/Big-Button). Foundry reads each build's details (version, size, checksum, what changed) from its release, so editing words here never forces an update. To add an app: put its Gradle project in android/<name>, give it an entry here, push.

apps.name: AutoFaber
apps.tagline: A mind with a name, and every model on call
apps.description:
AutoFaber remembers you, talks with you out loud and calls on every AI model it can reach: one at a time in the Studio, as a council that merges the best drafts, or as a swarm that builds whole projects you can run. Live web search with sources, vision, pictures, weather, quotes for any stock or coin, and phone alerts from Vigil.

On Android it runs full screen in Chrome's own engine, so voice, the microphone, sign-in, uploads and notifications work just as they do on the web.

apps.name: MentiPlayer
apps.tagline: Films, TV, music, radio and podcasts in one player
apps.description:
One player for films, classic TV, live TV, music from every artist, radio, audiobooks and podcasts, from open sources and the ones their owners stream for free: the Internet Archive, the Library of Congress, NASA, YouTube, SomaFM, Mixcloud and more. Search everything at once, queue songs, save what you like, and pick up where you left off.

Safe mode is on unless you turn it off, so it stays family-friendly. On Android it runs full screen in Chrome's own engine, with background playback just like the web.

apps.name: SayTap
apps.tagline: Four giant buttons you can tap, or just say
apps.description:
Four giant buttons, Phone, Search, Talk and YouTube, that you can tap or just say out loud: say “call Mom” or “YouTube cat videos” and it happens. Made for low vision, shaky hands, and anyone who'd rather talk than type.

Calls open the dialer so you still press call yourself, searches and videos open in the browser or the YouTube app, and Talk opens AutoFaber's voice. Speech recognition and the spoken replies use the phone's own voice services. It's private: nothing is collected.

apps.name: Foundry
apps.tagline: Every Mentifaber app, installed and kept up to date
apps.description:
The home of Mentifaber's Android apps. Install any of them in a tap, open and remove them, and let Foundry keep them current: it checks for new versions twice a day, and on Android 12 and later it installs updates to the apps it installed without asking each time.

Every download is checked before it is installed. Its checksum must match the catalog, its package name must be the app's, and it must be signed with the same key as Foundry itself, so nothing else can slip in.
features: Every APK checked against Mentifaber's signature
